passages.text: Burrow Google Ads, YouTube Ads & Cross-Platform Lessons Burrow solved a logistics problem (sofa delivery in apartment buildings) and made that solution the centerpiece of its marketing. The lesson: when a product feature solves a genuine friction point that competitors haven't addressed, that feature should be the ad's hero. Burrow also demonstrates how modular product architecture enables upsell ad sequences — existing customers are the highest-converting audience for 'add a piece' campaigns.
